title: QUIC RFC 9000 Maximum UDP Payload Size Receiver Limit Work Item
summary: Close the RFC 9000 Section 18.2 max_udp_payload_size receiver-processing gap by enforcing the local advertised receive limit before routed datagrams are posted to a connection runtime.
planned_changes:
- Add transport-parameter constants for the max_udp_payload_size default and QUIC v1 minimum.
- Publish a runtime endpoint effect when local transport parameters commit.
- Store per-connection max UDP payload size in the endpoint and drop routed datagrams that exceed it before PacketReceived posting.
- Add a dropped ingress disposition so host shells do not treat receive-limit drops as stateless-reset or pre-acceptance route misses.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for exact-limit routing, over-limit dropping, and local transport-parameter effect publication.
- Retarget REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0007 trace links from broad transport-parameter codec tests to direct receiver-limit proof.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S18P2-0007 and endpoint-routing regression requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: Path MTU discovery or peer send-size enforcement.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused endpoint dispatch and requirement-home proof for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0007.
